law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, 2018 (Act No. 4 of 2018)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 8(1)(f)); joint works 50 years after death of the author who dies first or life of the last, whichever is longer; audiovisual, collective, photographs and computer programmes 50 years from creation (s. 8(1)(a)); anonymous/pseudonymous 50 years from first made available (s. 8(3))
digital_protection: Technological protection measures: dedicated anti-circumvention Part in the Act (section not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
notes: Act replaces Copyright Act 1912 (life + 50 years); 2018 Act: 50 years for audiovisual/collective works, photographs, software (from creation), sound recordings (from publication) per secondary source; general life-based term unconfirmed; commencement by Minister's gazette notice not confirmed; Berne since 14 Dec 1998, WTO since 1 Jan 1995; WCT/WPPT unconfirmed; Assented 1 Mar 2018, published 9 Mar 2018; repealed Copyright Act 1912 (which gave life + 50). Term confirmed life + 50 only through the Commons summary (secondary), not the Act text, though the predecessor and the Commons summary agree. WTO 1 Jan 1995, Berne 14 Dec 1998. WCT/WPPT status not found.
